# TaxGuru

> > TaxGuru is India's comprehensive tax and regulatory compliance platform covering Income Tax, GST, Company Law, and Union Budget analysis.

TaxGuru provides authoritative tax guidance, legal documentation, court rulings, and policy analysis for Indian taxpayers and businesses. The platform aggregates tax notifications, judiciary decisions, and budget updates across multiple tax domains including direct taxes, indirect taxes, and corporate compliance.

## Key Topics

- Income Tax
- GST (Goods and Service Tax)
- Union Budget
- Tax Notifications
- Court Rulings
- Custom Duty
- TDS (Tax Deducted at Source)
- Company Law
- Capital Gains
- Tax Provisions
- GeM Registration
- SEBI Regulations
- FEMA Compliance
- SIP and Mutual Funds
- Tax Planning
